svg.title: Blue Red
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; interpretive screen colour not calibrated. Blue upright round-ended capsule touches top/bottom of red rectangular ground. Current museum oil/height metadata disagrees with older labels and verso; source notes retain conflict. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
